## Jira task

SHOPIL-... — link to the task

## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and affected components.

## Verification

List commands run and their results. Link or include reproducible evidence and state anything not verified.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The task's acceptance criteria are covered.
- [ ] No secrets, local databases, or generated data are included.
- [ ] Reused course code is attributed and changes are identified.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is updated.
